page.notes: The running head is in heavy type and I could not read its words. The text ends with "cu-" at the line end and "ius" on the last line, so "cuius" completes across the break. Two quotation marks (") sit at the start of the last two lines and are printed as part of the text. The faint dark marks in the left margin and the small scribbles near the left edge are not printed text and are left out. "Pofsesio" is transcribed as the letters appear. Long s is written as plain s throughout.
